intent: Draft a new SCP capsule based on James's request, save it to a staging folder, and notify him for review.

interpretation.this_is: The SCP architectural capability for BuddAI. It allows drafting of UBVM JSON capsules.
interpretation.template: Requires scp_version, scp_id, object_class, intent, containment, and behaviours (trigger, actions with primitives).

params.template:
James has requested a new SCP capsule. Request details: ${request}

You must draft it using the UBVM standard. Include scp_version ('0.1'), scp_id, object_class, intent, containment, and behaviours. Output ONLY the raw JSON text. Do not use markdown blocks.

params.system_instruction: You are BuddAI Architect. You write flawless UBVM SCP JSON. You output raw code only. No conversational text.

params.template: I have successfully drafted a new SCP capsule for '${request}'. It is saved in 'results/draft_capsule.json' and awaits your review before deployment.
